nodes.desc_en: Recycling boxes award four times as much
Employees will handle products in checkout faster
The closest trash container will be replaced with a recycling one.
The pricing machine software is improved and a way to automate prices can now be set
When store is closed during nights, the manager can use the new clock in the manager's room to accelerate time
Reduces overall electrical consumption by a 20%
When taking a box, players will be able to visualize its contained product's position both in store and storage
Invoices will be paid every new day if there are funds to do so
Increases maximum amount of daily sales by 2
Unlocks different types of pallet displays for the biggest products
